messages:
jamie: FYI the 2.3.1 hotfix PR is blocked on approvals. Need 2x LGTM before the 18:00 PT cutoff or the patch window closes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5123 :hourglass:
alex: i can give one approval after a quick lint + smoke, pinging @sasha for second. :+1:
sasha: on my list, give me ~20m. i'm juggling infra roll but will jump on the PR.
lee: re: failing integ test — I see this in the runner logs:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 0.02 <= 0.01
tests/test_kv_cache.py::test_cache_eviction
```
is that the same flaky test we've been seeing on rtx nodes?
alex: yep that's the one. quick workaround is to bump timeout in test, but i'd prefer to confirm it's not perf regression from the kv patch.
jamie: can we approve conditionally? if it passes staging smoke by 17:30, then merge; otherwise hold until followup fix.
sasha: i can do a focused review for logic + perf impact. if staging smoke passes, i'll LGTM by 17:40. :eyes:
release-bot: build/5123 - staging smoke started at 17:05 PT. status: running.
lee: i'm running the flaky test locally with rtx config now, will report back in ~10m.
alex: thanks — if anyone else is free, please take a look at lines 120-140 in kv_cache.py, that's where the eviction logic changed.
jamie: plan: monitor staging smoke, if green by 17:30 -> 2x LGTM then merge before 18:00 PT. if not, we postpone and open follow-up issue. tagging @sasha @alex @lee for visibility.
lee: smoke passed locally after a small seed tweak, pushing results to staging. will update here.
release-bot: build/5123 - staging smoke completed at 17:28 PT. status: ✅ passed.
alex: I left a minor nit, but not blocking. LGTM from me after nit addressed. :white_check_mark:
sasha: reviewed, verified perf counters look stable. LGTM. :rocket:
jamie: awesome — merging now. thanks everyone for the quick turn. :tada:
